comments.label: Kept joke
comments.anchor: This would be impressive if anyone had thrown a bottle against a hull.

comments.label: Formula
comments.anchor: The mistake is treating every tool as the same stage.
comments.note: This announces a conclusion instead of making it. Revision 2 names the useful split directly: CI handles mechanical checks; previews handle browser judgment.

comments.label: Too many props
comments.anchor: Naming branches becomes a small editorial act.
comments.note: By this point the essay had already used launches, a copy desk, a stage, and backstage. The branch names were useful; the extra theatre was not.

comments.label: Grand ending
comments.anchor: A better pipeline says some work is a note, some is a proof, some is a rehearsal, and some is the issue that goes to press.
comments.note: The sentence restated the previous paragraph at a higher emotional volume. Revision 2 ends with the expected operational effect of the branch policy.
